conventions.convention: QC14 families use exact H, T, T† and control-first CNOT gates, with polynomial-time full-list generation by one fixed one-tape machine from unary input length.
PromiseBPP has a polynomial bound on every random branch, independent fair bits, acceptance at least 2/3 on YES and at most 1/3 on NO, and no correctness requirement outside the promise.
ZQP means fixed-circuit bounded failure: correct definite output has probability at least 2/3, wrong definite output has probability zero, and all remaining outcomes are labelled ?.
The root inner product is linear in its first argument; the Dirac bra of y maps z to the root pairing of z with y, so the outer-product coordinate matrix is xy†.
Registers have positive dimension, ordered tensor factors and lexicographic product bases; the first bit is most significant and the zero-qubit register is C.
A zero-probability instrument outcome receives no conditional density operator; positive-probability outcomes are normalized branch operators.

Simon YES instances are injective maps on n-bit strings; NO instances have fibers exactly {x, x XOR s} for one nonzero mask. Oracle calls are charged separately from explicit implementation, and table codes are not accessible input data in the query model.

load_bearing.statement: An explicit topologically listed Boolean DAG with n inputs, m output ports, S non-input nodes and E input-port uses compiles in polynomial time into an exact QC14 XOR embedding, using at most S+E+1 clean work wires and at most 27(6S+4E+m) QC14 gate occurrences. The action holds on every basis input and arbitrary target string, and extends to superpositions.

A polynomial-size Boolean circuit family generated in the indexed-gate logspace sense, with a fixed polynomial bound on non-input nodes, has one deterministic polynomial-time generator of its complete self-delimiting topological gate lists, including input counts and designated outputs.

For two nonzero finite-dimensional registers with ordered orthonormal bases, conjugation by the lifted computational-basis projections forms finite instruments. For a unit vector with coefficients c(a,b), the register outcome probabilities are the corresponding sums of |c(a,b)|²; every positive-probability conditional state is the rank-one density operator of the normalized projected vector.

For n≥1, distinguish injective functions on {0,1}^n from functions whose fibers are exactly the pairs {x, x XOR s} for a nonzero mask s, using classical function queries or coherent XOR queries with separate query charges.

For every n≥1, each sample is uniform on V_n for YES and on s⊥ for NO. The rank test rejects every NO instance; its YES error is at most (2^n−1)2^{−(n+2)}<1/4. It uses exactly n+2 queries and O(n³) classical bit operations.

For N=2^n with n≥4, a classical randomized adaptive algorithm with only classical Simon function-query access and worst-case error at most 1/3 requires Ω(√N)=Ω(2^{n/2}) queries, with unrestricted classical computation between queries.

concerns.concern: Proof 2.1 says to query the type and predecessors of 'each of the at most q(n) nodes', whereas the Statement bounds only non-input nodes by q(n). The complete list can have n+q(n) nodes and must also describe its input nodes. Enumerating all n+q(n) nodes, or emitting the n input records separately, closes this small counting gap without changing the result.

The Definition ends with asserted resource properties: 'exactly n+2 oracle queries, 2n(n+2) ordinary Hadamard gates ... and O(n^3) classical bit operations'. The task's algorithm convention places complexity properties in separate proved results. The correctness theorem already proves the query and elimination bounds; the remaining direct counts should likewise be stated there.

seams_checked.note: EQP, ZQP and containment proofs retain the exact QC14 alphabet, full-list one-tape generation, terminal output predicates and promise conventions. The indexed conversion is proved locally rather than attributed to the supplier.

The compiler uses the supplier's XOR embedding, clean-work restoration and explicit bounds, then supplies its own exact QC14 replacements. Simon access uses the involutive XOR oracle without assuming controlled access.

H, T, T† and control-first CNOT matrices and chronological multiplication agree. Toffoli is constructed explicitly with a restored scratch wire; no approximate synthesis or implicit controlled-T operation is invoked.
The instrument proof consistently uses the linear-first root pairing and the outer-product matrix vv†.
Register order, big-endian bit labels, orthonormal product bases and factorwise tensor maps agree with the suppliers. Instrument registers are explicitly nonzero.

The local instrument lemma verifies complete positivity under every finite amplification and trace normalization for every operator. Conditional states are used only for positive-probability outcomes.
The explicit-table counterexample preserves the distinction between oracle-query charges and ordinary input-length runtime; it asserts no explicit-input quantum-versus-classical separation.
